summary: Woman from Chicago fell off a horse near Finch Lake Trailhead in Wild Basin, suffering a lower leg injury; rangers assisted her to the trailhead and she was transported by ambulance to Estes Park Medical Center.
location: Finch Lake Trailhead, Wild Basin, Rocky Mountain National Park
notes: Source: Estes Park News, "Six Incidents in Rocky Mountain National Park on Tuesday, August 14, 2012" — one of six same-day RMNP incidents; the Broadway Ledge pair from the same article is id 3086. Wild Basin is in Boulder County (cf. id 2675 Ouzel Falls).
